correctness.rationale: Every class of vertices with the same shore and initial color remains synchronized, so truncating every class multiplicity at two preserves exact update history for threshold two. The executable 6561-signature certificate exhausts the quotient and verifies F^11=F^7, precisely twelve capped fixed-by-four states (nine zero patterns, two alternating types, one full rotating), and the sharp size-phase diagram. The disjoint periodic orbit formula follows by labelled binomial/multinomial counting and division by primitive period four. An independent direct-state C++ implementation verified 4,657,408 labelled states at ten board sizes; a weighted check confirms the exact coefficient formula for basins. No empirical extrapolation replaces the exact quotient lemma.

value.rationale: Cooperative two-contact excitation is a natural and structurally distinct regime. The theorem classifies all attractor states of an entire two-parameter infinite graph family; its alternating and all-phase mechanisms have distinct sharp size thresholds of four and eight vertices per shore, while the exact transient cutoff jumps to seven only on sufficiently asymmetric large shores. The certificate-weighted exponential coefficient formula additionally resolves the entire first-entry/evenual-period basin census at every size, providing an exact dynamical benchmark beyond a routine case or arbitrary finite slice.
